scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix database && npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix client
scripts.db:prepare: npm run prisma:generate --prefix database && npm run db:migrate:deploy
scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:deploy && concurrently -n api,client "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run start --prefix client"
scripts.pro: concurrently -n api,client "npm run start:pro --prefix api" "npm run build --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix api && npm run test:ci --prefix client
